facts.text: The series is a direct continuation of Guy Ritchie's 2019 film of the same name — Theo James plays Eddie Horniman, the son of Matthew McConaughey's American drug lord Mickey Pearson from the movie.

Eddie Horniman becomes the 13th Duke of Halstead when his father's will passes him the family estate and title over his older brother Freddy (Daniel Ings) — skipped for his erratic behavior and drug habit — only to discover the estate is sitting on a massive cannabis farm.

Guy Ritchie co-wrote the pilot with Peaky Blinders producer Matthew Read and personally directed the first two episodes — a rare foray into television for the filmmaker, who otherwise stayed on as executive producer.

Season 2 (Netflix, premiered September 3, 2026, 8 episodes) picks up a year later and moves the operation from the buried cannabis farm under Halstead to Italy's lakeside villas — Theo James, Kaya Scodelario, and Ray Winstone return, joined by new cast including Hugh Bonneville.

Ray Winstone plays Bobby Glass, the incarcerated drug lord who actually runs the cannabis empire hidden on the estate, with his daughter Susie Glass (Kaya Scodelario) handling the day-to-day business Eddie gets pulled into.
